info.name: OBE - Lecturer Marks Upload (EC6306)
info.description:
Simplified collection for Lecturer to upload marks for module EC6306.

Pre-loaded User:
- danu1 (Lecturer) - password: 1234

Module: EC6306

Workflow:
1. Login as Lecturer (token auto-saved)
2. View Module EC6306 Details
3. Get Learning Outcomes for EC6306
   - If empty, create LOs using requests 3a, 3b, 3c first!
4. Download Excel Template
5. Upload All Marks (Bulk Upload)
6. Verify Uploaded Marks

⚠️ IMPORTANT:
- Make sure to login first! The JWT token is automatically saved to environment variable
- Authorization header uses: Bearer {{jwt_token}}
- Server must be running at http://localhost:8080
- If you get "Learning Outcome not found" error, you need to create LOs first (requests 3a, 3b, 3c)
- Use the EXACT LO IDs returned from request #3 in your template and upload requests

Base URL: http://localhost:8080

request.description:
Login as Lecturer (danu1). Token will be automatically saved to environment variable.

✅ After successful login:
- JWT token is saved as {{jwt_token}}
- User ID is saved as {{userID}}
- All subsequent requests will use this token automatically

⚠️ If you get authorization errors:
1. Make sure this login request succeeded (200 OK)
2. Check that you see the token in the response
3. The token is valid for the session

Pre-loaded lecturer accounts:
- danu1 (password: 1234)
- danu (password: 1234)
- danu2 (password: 1234)

Get all Learning Outcomes (LOs) for module EC6306.

✅ IMPORTANT: Use the LO IDs from this response for template generation and mark upload.

If this returns empty [], you need to create Learning Outcomes first using request 3a, 3b, 3c.

Create Learning Outcome LO1 for module EC6306.

⚠️ Only run this if request #3 returned empty [].

You can customize:
- id: The unique LO identifier (e.g., "LO1", "EC6306-LO1")
- name: Display name
- description: What this LO covers
- credits: Credit weight

Create Learning Outcome LO2 for module EC6306.

⚠️ Only run this if request #3 returned empty [].

Create Learning Outcome LO3 for module EC6306.

⚠️ Only run this if request #3 returned empty [].

Download Excel template for marks entry.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: To download the Excel file:
1. Click the dropdown arrow next to 'Send' button
2. Select 'Send and Download'
3. File will save to your Downloads folder

If you just click 'Send', you'll see gibberish text - that's normal! It's the Excel binary data. Use 'Send and Download' instead.

Adjust the request body:
- losIds: Array of LO IDs from step 3 (e.g., ["LO1", "LO2", "LO3"])
- markType: "FINAL_EXAM" or "ASSIGNMENT"
- batch: Batch year (e.g., "22", "23", "24")

The template will download as: mark_template_{batch}_{markType}.xlsx

request.description:
✅ BULK UPLOAD: Upload marks for ALL LOs in ONE request!

This uploads the entire Excel file at once - no need to upload separately for each LO.

Steps:
1. Click 'Body' tab
2. Click 'Select Files' for excelFile
3. Choose your filled Excel template
4. Update losIds with your actual LO IDs (comma-separated, matching column order)
5. Update batch if needed
6. Update markType if needed
7. Click Send

Example:
If your Excel has columns: Student Index | LO1 | LO2 | LO3
Then losIds should be: LO1,LO2,LO3

The order matters! LO IDs must match the column order in Excel.

⚠️ TROUBLESHOOTING:

If you get "Access to the resource is prohibited":
1. ✓ Make sure you logged in first (request #1)
2. ✓ Check that Authorization header shows: Bearer {{jwt_token}}
3. ✓ Verify your user role is 'lecture', 'admin', or 'superadmin'
4. ✓ Token must be valid (try logging in again)

If you get "Learning Outcome not found":
1. ✓ Run request #3 to get actual LO IDs from database
2. ✓ Use exact LO IDs (case-sensitive)
3. ✓ Make sure LOs exist for module EC6306

If you get "Error importing marks":
1. ✓ Check Excel file format matches template
2. ✓ Verify Student Index column has valid student IDs
3. ✓ Make sure mark columns match losIds parameter order
